family.tagline: Seedlings in the yard, orders and journals on the Core.
family.story: Tomas grows seeds and seedlings in the back yard. Luz is an electrician on call. With three children and a greenhouse, their orders, journal and mailing list live on one Companion Core.

members.name: Tomas
members.work: runs the seed and seedling shop

companion.name: Juniper
companion.job: Opens Grist in its own browser and updates the seedling stock sheet.
companion.limits: Edits one sheet at a time. Tomas checks it.

companion.name: Ramon
companion.job: Drafts the day's job list and callback notes from what Luz texts it.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Luz sends every message.

popup.title: A parcel on the veranda
popup.body: Luz finds a parcel on the veranda, Elio on her hip. She carries it through the stair hall and the living room to the desk in the living bay.

popup.title: Marcos helps unpack
popup.body: Marcos helps open it. Inside: the Companion Core, a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive. The Core covers about three quarters of a sheet of paper.

popup.title: Plug in, press the button
popup.body: Tomas plugs in the power cable. Luz presses the button. The Core wakes and opens its own Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Joined, one phone at a time
popup.body: Luz joins the Core's own Wi-Fi from her phone, held out of Ines's reach. Then she picks the home network and types its password.

popup.title: Agents and apps, chosen
popup.body: In Companion Hub, Tomas picks OpenClaw and Luz picks Hermes. They add Grist, HortusFox and Yuvomi, and leave Companion Memory (beta) for later. Then they walk away.

beats.capability: OpenClaw is an agent with its own browser and coding tools, running in its own sandbox, with iOS

popup.title: Juniper says hello
popup.body: Tomas types a first message to the agent he named Juniper. Juniper answers, and the Core is running.

say.speaker: tomas
say.text: Hello, Tomas. Juniper here. Which sheet first?

beats.capability: Listen to your audiobooks and podcasts, and pick up where you left off on any device

popup.title: Tonight's story, picked by Ines
popup.body: Evenings here are for listening. Ines picks tonight's story, and Audiobookshelf plays it from the Core. Tomorrow it picks up where the family stopped.

beats.capability: Hermes runs in its own sandbox on your Core and talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Ramon drafts the callbacks
popup.body: After a late call-out, Luz texts Ramon the day's visits from the couch. Ramon drafts the callback notes, and Luz sends each one herself.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: luz
say.text: Notes drafted. Please read each one before you send it.

beats.capability: A family planner with a shared calendar, tasks, shopping, meals, notes, contacts and budget in one

popup.title: One calendar for five
popup.body: Luz moves the on-call shifts, the school pickups and Sunday supper into Yuvomi's shared calendar at the counter. Tomas sees it on his phone.

beats.capability: Track the pantry, shopping lists, recipes

popup.title: Jars counted, list written
popup.body: Tomas counts the jars of preserved tomatoes in Grocy, standing by the fridge. The shopping list shows what the family still needs.

beats.capability: A spreadsheet-database with real Python formulas, stored as a SQLite file you can copy

popup.title: Juniper keeps the stock sheet
popup.body: Seedling stock changes by the hour. Juniper opens Grist in its own browser and updates the sheet from Tomas's counts. Tomas checks it.

beats.capability: Draw logos, diagrams and line art as vector graphics, in your browser

popup.title: A new label, drawn at home
popup.body: Tomas draws the Cinder Hill packet label in Inkscape, in his browser. Marcos picks the color for the tomatoes.

beats.capability: Translate text and documents on your own Core

popup.title: Packets in two languages
popup.body: Tomas runs the sowing notes for the new packets through LibreTranslate on the Core. Luz fixes the Spanish before the labels are printed.

beats.capability: Write and send newsletters to your own mailing list

popup.title: The newsletter, list and all
popup.body: Tomas writes the spring newsletter in Listmonk. The mailing list of local gardeners stays on the Core, and he presses send himself.

beats.capability: Create and share invoices in seconds, with secure client links

popup.title: The day's invoices, one per order
popup.body: Tomas writes today's invoices in Invio, one for each order. They sit on the Core beside the stock sheet, and he checks every one.

beats.capability: Track accounts, budgets, bills and savings goals, with rules that sort your transactions

popup.title: The month's accounts, sorted
popup.body: After supper, Tomas imports the month's bank file into Firefly III from a CSV. Its rules sort the transactions into seed sales and supplies.

beats.capability: Lists, boards and calendars for tasks, with reminders and recurring jobs

popup.title: Tomorrow's jobs, by the door
popup.body: Boots on the mat, tool bag on the hook. Luz sorts tomorrow's call-outs into a Vikunja board before she goes up.

beats.capability: A shared whiteboard on an infinite canvas

popup.title: Raised beds, drawn twice
popup.body: Marcos sketches next year's raised beds at the easel. Then he redraws the plan with Tomas on tldraw, and it stays on the Core.

beats.capability: Run a quiz night for a small group on your own Core

popup.title: A beetle round for quiz night
popup.body: Marcos hosts Sunday's quiz night in Razzia, with a round on beetles. Everyone plays on a phone, and the game runs on the Core.

beats.capability: Browse and share your photo library, with automatic tagging, without uploading it anywhere

popup.title: Baby photos, kept close
popup.body: Beside Elio's crib, Luz browses the baby photos in PhotoPrism. They stay on the Core, and automatic tags help her find them.

beats.capability: Track your plants, watering and care history across rooms and beds, with photos and a garden journal

popup.title: The first tomato flower
popup.body: Marcos waters the tomato seedlings and photographs the first flower. He adds it to HortusFox, where Tomas keeps the garden journal.

beats.capability: Control and automate your smart home from one place, locally, without a cloud account

popup.title: A vent that opens on schedule
popup.body: Luz has wired the greenhouse vent herself. Home Assistant opens it on a schedule from the Core, over the home Wi-Fi.

beats.capability: Plan, map and share hiking and biking routes from GPX files

popup.title: Sunday's walk, mapped at home
popup.body: On Sundays the family walks round the pond. Tomas draws the route from a GPX file in Wanderer, and the map stays on the Core.

popup.title: Seeds, orders and one Core
popup.body: Three children, one greenhouse and one Companion Core. The Eriksen-Bautista family keeps its orders, its journal and its mailing list at home.

closing.body: Keep your orders, your garden journal and your mailing list on a Companion Core at home. Then spend the early morning in the greenhouse.

notes: FTUE follows the owner-specified hotspot flow; the fact sheet says only "plug it in, pair it over Wi-Fi, and walk away". Owner sign-off open.
No TV by choice: living-story is the media beat at the couch and never names a TV or a screen. The house has no kitchen island, so the kitchen beats say the counter.
Neither companion has Companion Memory connected. ftue-pick says the family leaves it for later, which is the opt-in story.
garden-vent assumes the family has a Wi-Fi vent actuator; it is not in the Core parcel or in the 3D scene. Home Assistant has no USB or Zigbee here.

Newsletter beat claims no delivery: Listmonk needs an SMTP provider or mail server to send. Check the wording with the owner. Razzia is a quiz night for a small group; Wanderer plans routes from GPX files.
